_readme: Curated map of slug -> upstream base host(s) that bin/check-source-endpoints probes directly, built cycle 2150 to close the unbuilt half of the c2124 item (bin/check-upstream-warnings reads what RIVALS say; nothing probed OUR upstreams directly). Hosts were verified by grepping each actors/<slug>/src/main.js for literal https:// URLs on non-comment lines (registry.json carries no upstream field -- checked first, confirmed absent). Exclusions made by hand after reading context, not mechanically: remote-jobs-scraper's 'https://fetchsmith.com' at main.js:19 is our own User-Agent string, not a fetch target; substack-scraper's 'https://astralcodexten.substack.com' is a documented DEFAULT_PUBLICATION_URLS sample, not a fixed upstream (the real fixed host is substack.com's own /api/v1/categories); website-screenshot-scraper's 'https://example.com' is a placeholder default for an arbitrary user-supplied URL. scholarship-scraper excluded entirely (status=retired in registry.json, not a live Actor). Re-derive by re-running the grep in notes/LEARNINGS.md cycle 2150 if an Actor's main.js changes.

exempt.website-screenshot-scraper: renders arbitrary user-supplied URLs via Chromium -- no single fixed upstream to probe, same exemption bin/check-upstream-warnings already uses for this Actor
exempt.shopify-products-scraper: fetches arbitrary user-supplied storeUrl's /products.json -- no single fixed upstream, same shape as website-screenshot-scraper
exempt.google-play-reviews-scraper: upstream reached only through the google-play-scraper npm package, which has no literal host string in our own src/main.js to probe (it talks to Google Play's internal, undocumented endpoints)
